assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game terrain albedo texture for a modern Korean mountain-valley flight simulator, viewed from aircraft altitude and also usable as a large-scale ground macro map. Primary request: create a seamless square top-down terrain material showing humid Korean highland vegetation, dark forest masses, muted grass, exposed brown earth, subtle rocky drainage and irregular cultivated clearings. Style/medium: realistic painterly satellite-orthographic game texture, physically plausible natural surface, fine material detail but no identifiable buildings or roads. Composition/framing: exact orthographic top-down square; evenly distributed multi-scale detail; edges must tile seamlessly; no horizon and no perspective. Lighting/mood: diffuse overcast illumination baked as little as possible; no cast shadows and no directional sun. Color palette: deep olive and pine green, restrained moss, weathered umber earth, cool gray rock; avoid neon/lime greens. Materials/textures: vegetation canopies as broad natural masses, soil and stone breakup at medium scale, subtle near grain. Constraints: no aircraft, no vehicles, no people, no text, no watermark, no border, no labels, no rivers wider than a narrow drainage line; must not look like camouflage blotches or obvious procedural noise. Avoid: repeated stamps, hard rectangular fields, visible seams, dramatic shadows, aerial perspective, clouds, sky, glossy surfaces.
